revolver · live russian roulette, played in dares

Load a dare, challenge another Bluesky handle, and once you both agree, take turns pulling the trigger — live. One bullet, chambers of your choosing. Whoever's still standing at the end gets to see the loser post the dare that was waiting for them.

How it actually posts: it doesn't, automatically. If you lose, you get a ready-made post with the winner's dare in it and a button to send it — nothing leaves your account without you clicking that button yourself. You'll see both dares before you agree to anything, and you can back out any time before the trigger's pulled.
